name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-disco
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Disco
description:
It's the BG from the last level of Gokujou Parodius. Uses an ExGFX file and a few tiles, and the palette is ExAnimated. To be used in a club level of some sorts.

Update: Some adjustments have been made:
-I moved tile 227 to 100 as tile 100 has been replaced with tile F8, freeing 1 tile;
-Added the big pole tiles and modified the lower tiles for compatibility with the BG. It was easy as it used the same palette;
-Map16 has been optimized, along with the addition of the big pole tiles;
-Added 2 HDMA files: 1 used for most of the level and the 2nd one was used while trying to avoid the giant Chichibinta Rika.

You should use the HDMA after the back area color is set to black.

Credit not required.
